content.title: Frontend Development Internship · Potential Inc
content.summary: Frontend internship focused on Next.js and React applications, reusable UI components, and responsive interfaces.
content.body: October 2025 – March 2026. Worked on frontend applications using Next.js and React. Developed reusable UI components and responsive interfaces, and collaborated with developers and designers in an agile workflow.
content.notes: This entry describes the supplied internship experience. It does not claim ownership of work that was produced by a team or belongs to the employer.

evidence.claim: The supplied CV lists a Full-Stack Developer Intern role at Potential Inc from October 2025 to March 2026, including Next.js, React, reusable UI components, responsive interfaces, and agile collaboration.
